tools.name: sentry_issues
tools.description: Sentry issues, last seen first by default. Each has its short id, title, culprit, events, users, first and last seen, and link.

query.description: Sentry search, such as release:4.2.0 or checkout.

tools.name: sentry_issue
tools.description: One Sentry issue as text: its latest stack trace, app frames first with the line that ran, the request, breadcrumbs and tags.

id.description: A short id such as WEB-3F, or the numeric id.

tools.name: sentry_update
tools.description: Resolve, ignore or reopen a Sentry issue, or assign it. Only when the person asked for it.

assign.description: me, user:<id>, team:<id>, or empty to unassign.

tools.name: sentry_comment
tools.description: Comment on a Sentry issue as the person, in markdown. Only when they asked for it.

tools.name: sentry_releases
tools.description: A project's recent releases, newest first: new issues each brought, last deploy, and crash-free sessions and users.
